A is better. It is much closer to the "under 120 words" limit, at roughly 117–126 words depending on whether the title and disclaimer are counted. B runs to about 200 words, clearly breaching the limit. Both responses cover the key terms accurately: rent amount, CPI collar, year-5 market review, the dispute process, outgoings and notice. A does it in a scannable form that suits a busy manager. B adds a redundant intro and closing recap, which is the padding the brief was meant to avoid.

**A**
